source.citation: Nair et al., Design engineering a walking robotic manipulator for in-space assembly missions, Frontiers in Robotics and AI 9, 2022

modelled_parameters.geometry_reconstruction_note: The paper supplies topology, tubular form and approximate 1.3 m prototype envelope; exact segment allocation and radii below are reconstruction choices, not published CAD dimensions.
modelled_parameters.collision_geometry: matching analytical/MJCF capsule axes and radii; URDF uses cylinders because it has no capsule primitive
modelled_parameters.inertia_method: diagonal rigid-body approximations from primitive geometry
modelled_parameters.gravity_assumption: fixed attitude-stabilized spacecraft base; gravity disabled by the experiment
